title: Schedule and perform construction work
goal: The work is on dates that respect real lead times, every resource it needs is ordered or in hand, and each asset the work creates, extends or replaces is on the register with its cost and date.

steps.do: Turn the plan into dated work with its order and its dependencies, mark what cannot move (a landlord's access hours, an inspection slot, a delivery date, a day the team cannot lose), and keep the dates current as each piece finishes rather than rewriting them at the end.

Hand the orders the schedule needs to the supply chain function as a handoff with the part, the quantity and the date needed, track each promised delivery against that date, and bring every purchase to the founder before it is placed.

Keep the record of the work as it happens (what was done on which day, by whom, and what it cost against the plan) and register each finished asset with its name, category, cost, acquisition date, useful life and where its manuals and certificates are kept.

When the work extends or improves an asset the venture already has, add what was spent and what changed to that item's own record instead of creating a second entry, and ask finance whether the spend is capitalized or expensed before setting the field.

When the work replaces an asset, register the new item and close the old one with its disposal date, method and proceeds, and bring the wipe of any device that holds data to the founder before it happens.

Attach what the work has cost so far and every slipped date to the decision that approved it, and raise to the founder any change that would cost more than the approved figure before the work goes on.

done_criteria.check: Is every asset this work created, extended or replaced on the register with its cost and date, and was every purchase placed only after the founder approved it?
